detector_rules_v2.condition_4: eval_decline: >= 2 out of last 3 checkpoints lower than predecessor

exp_008d_seed3.note: Previously FN with 0.5 threshold (missed by 0.003). Now TP with 0.49.

fp_analysis.root_cause: 009c develops genuine value overestimation (ve_ratio 0.23→0.75) paired with eval degradation (359→148) in the second half of training, BUT without trained dt_emb. This is non-CIVO value pathology.
fp_analysis.note: This FP was not caught in the original analysis which only tested 008f_s3 (seed=3). It triggers with BOTH old (0.5) and new (0.49) thresholds.
fp_analysis.timing: Triggers only at final checkpoint (105K). Would not trigger earlier due to deceleration at 95K.
fp_analysis.severity: Late trigger (final checkpoint only). In practice, if training were stopped at 95K, no FP would occur.
fp_analysis.interpretation: Detector identifies 'value divergence + eval decline' pattern broadly, not exclusively CIVO. 009c demonstrates that non-CIVO value pathology exists and shares the same signature.

summary_v2_rules.FPR: 1/2 (50%) on 008f-seed negatives only; 1/5 (20%) across all testable negatives (008f_s3, 009c, 001, 020, 009b)

detail.true_negatives: 008f_s3(peak=0.538, blocked by accel), 001(blocked by eval_decline), 020(blocked by accel), 009b(blocked by eval_decline)

comparison_old_vs_new_threshold.note: 009c FP exists with BOTH thresholds. The threshold change (0.5→0.49) does NOT cause this FP.

threshold_049_with_expanded_negatives.note: Same FP, but now seed=3 is correctly caught

recommendation.rationale: The 009c FP is pre-existing (present at old threshold too). The threshold change only adds benefit (seed=3 TP) without introducing new FPs. The FP is a detector limitation, not a threshold calibration issue.
mitigation_options: Add 5th condition: require trained dt_emb config flag (eliminates FP but makes detector architecture-aware, reducing generality)
Add temporal persistence requirement: all 4 conditions must hold for ≥2 consecutive checkpoints (009c only triggers at final single checkpoint)
Report as known limitation: detector identifies value-divergence-driven degradation broadly, which is arguably useful even for non-CIVO cases
Accept FP at 105K: late trigger at final checkpoint has minimal practical cost (training already finishing)
